title: BizuraPay
tagline: BizuraPay is Business to Business payment system powered by zero knowledge technology and PayPalUSD
description: BizuraPay is a zero-knowledge powered business to business payments platform powered by zero knowledge technology. It lets merchants prove their identity via circom circuit and once identity gets verified privately, then merchants can instantly send or receive thier payments in stable coins like PYUSD.
how_its_made: This project uses zkSnark and circom for the zk proof and verification of generated proof. We have also used reown for connecting any wallet with our DeFi App. We have also created smart contract using solidity for storing public signals and verify data. Also we have implemented transfer functionality using abi and paypal USD token address for PYUSD payment methods.
